name: 🛡️ AdGuardian - AI Advertising Compliance Agent 🌍
description: AI Agent for Advertising Compliance and Content Audit

paragraphs: AdGuardian is an intelligent AI agent specialized in advertising compliance and marketing content auditing. It helps businesses ensure their advertising materials comply with regulatory standards across different countries while identifying potential legal issues before publication.
features: Real-time Streaming Analysis: Watch AI think and analyze in real-time
Transparent Reasoning: View complete AI thought processes (expandable sections)
Multiple AI Models: Choose from free and limited-free premium models
Multi-Country Standards: USA, China, UK, Japan, Korea, Singapore, Malaysia
Multi-Language Analysis: Support for English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean
